driver.hash_semantics: final bytes before this successor's snapshot; a future launch lock must match these actual bytes and a fresh plan hash

tests.scope: static/synthetic/mock regression only; no scientific fixture, search, census, calibration, timing panel, control panel, lock, or RUN

future_machine_protection.preservation: fsync staging progress after each fixture acceptance/rejection, completed start/certificate, and completed cell

future_cost_accounting.policy: DEC-20260907-38017a makes historical wall/CPU estimates advisory. They are measured, not future stop/invalidation gates.

future_algorithm.fixture_selection: first 32 p at b=9,11 and B=0..31, lexicographically; record singular/supersingular/subgroup rejections; select first two eligible distinct p per b or declare incomplete without widening
future_algorithm.availability: pooled-side: Zcoord>0 and sum(Znull_j)>0; retain all seven null arms and their work even where an individual Znull_j=0
future_algorithm.certificates: zero denominator is fruitless; nonzero denominator with verification failure is a failed certificate and invalidates through the single validity reduction
controls: executed all-start constant-O reset census with zero nonzero denominators and zero solves
future_algorithm.decision: one global all-u positive/negative/inconclusive decision after each u's 32 cells and four curve means; unavailable valid cells are retained and make the decision inconclusive

future_artifacts.publication: same-filesystem sibling staging, per-file fsync/hash verification, complete-set verification, fsync directory, atomic rename, retained typed publication-failure receipt

required_review_bindings: archive receipt binds review task and report hash
PASS report binds the corrected source snapshot

remaining_gate: Coordinator snapshots the six exact files under TASK-20260907-916ec4, then obtains a new independent source-bound implementation review before any measurement admission.
